title: Localized Degenerate Control of Navier-Stokes
exact_target: Can one find and effectively construct finitely many forcing modes confined to any chosen region that control the fluid approximately or in all finite projections, with the modes independent of viscosity?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 6500007 (AMR-064-0007). CC BY 4.0.
A. A. Agrachev, \emph{Some open problems}, arXiv:1304.2590v2 (2013), Section VII, pp. 8--9.
